description: This file defines a SearchEngine object that performs case-insensitive search across Video on Demand (VOD), Electronic Program Guide (EPG), and Favorite items within a media application. It includes data classes for search results and implements filtering logic based on query matching.

classes.name: SearchResult
classes.description: Sealed class representing different types of search results: Vod, Epg, and FavoriteVod.

classes.name: SearchGroupedResults
classes.description: Data class holding grouped search result lists for VOD, EPG, and Favorites.

methods.name: search
methods.description: Performs a case-insensitive search across VOD, EPG, and Favorites based on the query string.

methods.name: matches
methods.description: Helper function that checks if the query matches the title or description of an item.
